An '''incubation droid''' was a dome-shaped droid with an arm on its side and a shiny finish. In [[37 ABY]], one was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] to deliver [[uvak]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] into a pen during a [[Uvak competition|competition]] among the youth of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].
